speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any recent fevers, or have you experienced any bleeding or bruising?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Adult T-cell Leukemia/Lymphoma (ATLL) or Advanced Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis, Supraclavicular Node Ultrasound. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral Blood Smear, Flow Cytometry, Serum LDH, HCV/HBV/EBV Serology.
